method: exact enumeration of 8000 equally probable three-d20 paths per configuration; no Monte Carlo confidence intervals
assumptions: highest-level operative leads all three phases
all configured lead skills use same high or moderate benchmark
balanced all non-leads have relevant rank support; sparse only lowest-level non-lead supports
all failed wages paid in full
unlimited qualified contract deck for steady-state throughput
one complete job interval followed by one interval if recovery applies
no feat, infrastructure, trained prep unless explicitly named in sensitivity
no hiring, action, event, officer, asset costs included in per-job figures; lease deducted separately
